regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing, non-directional rotation with Banks (H + HK) as the crowded, mean-reverting leader and Energy (H-shares) as the trending challenger. The absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control for this market (gate_helps true), but only 5 of 17 themes are eligible, and all themes are unscorable except the two China Tech themes (3033.HK) sitting at the bottom of the rank. Backtest verdict confirms cross-sectional momentum is an attention lens only, not alpha, so this note expresses judgment through conditionals, not edge claims.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the margin between leader Banks and challenger Energy keeps shrinking (currently 0.215 with rotation.directional=false). The condition that would retire this watch is Banks losing the #1 rank to Energy for two consecutive detector prints, which would mark the first confirmed leadership handoff rather than a predicted one.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only eligible theme with a clean trend hurst_tag (0.71 durability, second-highest of all eligible names) and is the rotation challenger to Banks despite Banks' crowding flag. Given gate_helps is true, staying with an eligible, trending, non-crowded challenger over the crowded, mean-reverting leader expresses the one validated leg: drawdown/shake-out avoidance via the absolute-trend gate, not a return forecast.
evidence: Energy ranks #2 with score 1.198 and eligible=true
hurst_tag = trend with durability_bar 0.71 (highest among eligible)
crowding_z = 0.31 and crowded=false (Banks is crowded=true at z=1.15)
rotation.challenger is Energy, margin to leader is thin at 0.215
theses.dissent: Energy is only #2 behind a crowded leader, and the rotation view is explicitly 'narrowing' with absorption 0.45 and directional=false — the challenger may simply stall while Banks keeps the focus, and a 0.71 durability bar on a trend tag in a mean-reverting broad market (Hang Seng) can break quickly.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) theme loses its eligible status or its durability_bar falls below 0.55 before 2026-12-09

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks leads the rank but with a mean-revert hurst_tag and crowded=true (z=1.15), which is the documented reflexivity failure-mode: fading the leader on a crowding flag is forbidden, but so is treating it as a buy simply because it leads. Given the narrowing, non-directional rotation and crowding texture, the honest conditional lean is to avoid adding to an attention-concentrated, mean-reverting theme rather than overweight it for momentum reasons.
evidence: Banks ranks #1 with score 1.413 but hurst_tag = mean-revert
theses.dissent: Banks is the dominant leader with breadth 0.846 and the highest score, and crowding is only a size-down caution, never a fade — in a regime where the Hang Seng keeps paying for financials, staying flat could lag a persistent leader.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) durability_bar climbs back above 0.70 or its hurst_tag flips to trend before 2026-11-29

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is the only scorable technology theme (ETF proxy 3033.HK) but sits at rank #13 with score -0.89, mean-revert hurst_tag, and is ineligible. Under the detector's discipline, ineligible mean-reverting laggards deserve no directional lean beyond avoid — this is a stay-out conditional, not a short or a predicted reversal.
evidence: China Tech & Internet rank #13, score -0.89, eligible=false
etf_proxy = 3033.HK (scorable=true) so the call can be graded
crowding_z = -0.88 (uncrowded but still below eligible threshold)
theses.dissent: Tech is uncrowded and deeply out of favor, and in a reflexive reversal regime the most-hated sector can bounce hardest on any macro or policy surprise (unscheduled_share is 1.0, meaning headline-driven volatility is high).

falsifier.text: 3033.HK returns more than +10% over any rolling 10-day window before 2026-12-04

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
